meta.why: Removed from the country file: web-checked and confirmed not to be published documents — synthesised meta/framing nodes, geographic areas, industries, projects, institutions. Banned by data spec 2b/2c. Kept here in full so nothing is lost.

reports.title: Turkey foundational statistical-system meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from TurkStat and CBRT sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding the TurkStat institutional core, population, national accounts, CPI, CBRT institutional role and BOP into the opening foundation layer for Turkish research.
reports._notes: Opening integrating node for Turkish research.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch

reports.title: Turkey labour–industry–tourism–EU densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from TurkStat, CBRT and EU sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding labour force and unemployment statistics, industrial production, tourism arrivals and revenue, EU–Türkiye Customs Union framing, and Türkiye–EU merchandise trade into a coherent activity–services–external layer.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
National accounts, CPI, BOP and CBRT series from Batch 1

reports.title: Turkey fiscal–monetary–banking densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from Treasury, CBRT and BRSA sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding central government budget, public debt, CBRT monetary policy and policy rates, exchange-rate/lira statistics, banking system structure and NPL statistics into a coherent fiscal–monetary–financial layer.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
CPI, BOP and macro series from earlier batches

reports.title: Turkey provincial–agriculture–energy densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from TurkStat and energy sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding Istanbul, Ankara and Izmir GRDP series, agriculture and crop production statistics, and electricity generation/capacity into a coherent spatial–primary–energy layer.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
National accounts, industry and macro series from earlier batches

reports.title: Turkey FTA–education–provincial densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from Trade Ministry, TurkStat and related sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding the FTA network framing, key bilateral FTAs (UK, Korea, EFTA), education/literacy/attainment statistics, and the GRDP series for Kocaeli, Bursa, Antalya and Gaziantep into a coherent commerce–human-capital–further-provincial layer.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
EU Customs Union, tourism, industry and earlier provincial series

reports.title: National defence and security policy framing
reports.publisher: Ministry of National Defence / Ministry of Foreign Affairs / related
reports.description: Official framing of Türkiye’s defence and security policy, emphasising territorial integrity, self-defence, comprehensive approaches to contemporary threats, and contributions to collective defence and crisis management. Continuously cited in strategic and foreign-policy analysis.
reports._notes: Core policy-frame node for Turkish defence posture.
_referenced_by: Defence budget statistics
NATO membership framing
Regional and external security analysis

reports.title: Turkey defence–security densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from MoND, fiscal and alliance sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding defence and security expenditure, national defence policy framing, and NATO membership/collective defence framing into a coherent defence and security layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the defence densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Fiscal, external and earlier strategy series

reports.title: Eastern and southeastern lagging-regions framing
reports.publisher: Derived from TurkStat provincial and poverty sources
reports.description: System-level view of the eastern and southeastern provinces that form the lagging cluster in national regional accounts and poverty analysis. These regions account for a disproportionate share of remaining poverty relative to their GDP contribution.
reports._notes: Key equity / lagging-region spatial node that contrasts with Istanbul–Ankara–Izmir and industrial Marmara provinces.
_referenced_by: Provincial GRDP rankings
Poverty and living-standards analysis
National development and regional policy

reports.title: Regional disparity and convergence framing
reports.publisher: Derived from TurkStat and development sources
reports.description: Analytical and policy framing of inter-provincial and inter-regional disparities in GDP per capita, poverty and development outcomes. Continuously referenced in regional policy, investment incentives and equity discussions.
reports._notes: System-level equity frame linking the dual spatial structure of the Turkish economy.
_referenced_by: Lagging-regions and high-income provincial nodes
Poverty and social analysis
National development planning

reports.title: Turkey lagging-region densification meta-node
reports.description: Meta-node binding eastern/southeastern lagging-regions framing, Van and Şanlıurfa GRDP series, and regional disparity/convergence framing into a coherent equity and lagging-region layer that complements the high-income provincial set.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the lagging-region densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Istanbul, Ankara, Izmir, Kocaeli, Bursa, Antalya, Gaziantep and poverty series

reports.title: Social protection and assistance framing
reports.publisher: Derived from national and development sources
reports.description: Policy and statistical framing of social assistance, cash transfers and related social-protection programmes. Continuously referenced in poverty-reduction and equity analysis, especially under high-inflation conditions.
reports._notes: Social-protection densification linked to the poverty and fiscal clusters.
_referenced_by: Poverty and living-conditions statistics
Fiscal and budget analysis
Lagging-regions framing

reports.title: Turkey health–poverty densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from TurkStat and social sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding life expectancy and vital statistics, poverty and living-conditions statistics, and social-protection framing into a coherent health and welfare layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the health and poverty densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
CPI, labour, lagging-regions and fiscal series from earlier batches

reports.title: Digital economy framing
reports.publisher: Derived from Trade Ministry and related sources
reports.description: Policy and analytical framing of the digital economy and digitalisation of commerce, services and public services. Continuously referenced in competitiveness, SME and platform-economy discussions.
_referenced_by: E-commerce statistics
Services and labour analysis
National development planning

reports.title: Turkey digital–climate densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from Trade Ministry and climate sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding e-commerce volume statistics, digital economy framing, GHG inventory statistics, and NDC climate framing into a coherent digital and climate layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the digital and climate densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Services, energy, power and earlier macro series
